profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Google, Technical Advisor to the CFO on AI Infrastructure & Efficiency
profile.summary: Experienced engineering lead focused on building usable, supportable, and scalable infrastructure. I value data-driven decision making and effective, agile teams.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer, Technical Advisor to the CFO
positions.description:
Technical Advisor to the CFO on AI Infrastructure & Efficiency 

I guide investment decisions by analyzing technical capabilities in model development, hardware acceleration, and data center build-outs. My focus is optimizing the ratio of compute performance to capital expense across the serving and training stack.


Specialization:
- Hardware/Software Co-design: Navigating silicon selection and cluster build-outs.
- Model Lifecycle: optimizing the cost-latency-throughput curve for large-scale training and inference.

positions.title: Senior Staff Engineer - Office of the CFO
Senior Staff Software Engineer - Databases
positions.description:
Senior Tech lead for Cloud and Infrastructure Databases SRE. Led a team of 130 engineers to develop efficient, scalable, and reliable services for both GCP and Google-internal customers. Services included CloudSQL, Spanner, Bigtable, Firestore, Datastream, and several new to-be-launched product offerings. 

Initiated, structured, and led a transformative engineering program of 20+ people to deliver $XXXM in resource savings for Spanner.

positions.title: Staff Engineer
positions.description: Senior Tech Lead for Infrastructure Storage, responsible for the technical direction of 60 SREs and the reliability, efficiency, and operations of Bigtable, Spanner, AppEngine Storage, and Logs. Personally spearheaded the XX% improvement of Spanner compute and storage utilization.

positions.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Tech Lead for Infrastructure Storage, responsible for the technical direction of 60 SREs and the reliability, efficiency, and operations of Bigtable, Spanner, AppEngine Storage, and Logs. Personally spearheaded the XX% improvement of Spanner compute and storage utilization.  	 	

Previously at Google, I was the founding tech lead for Cloud Capacity Forecasting. Led a team to build a platform for forecasting the hardware requirements of Google Cloud products using statistical modeling. Architected a hybrid solution on GCP and Google’s internal stack.

My Initial role at Google was a Bigtable Site Reliability Engineer. Led a 2 year transformational project to migrate a critical high-throughput user-data store between Bigtable instances. Received a double promotion and a Feats of Engineering award. Participated in on-call rotation and incident response.

positions.title: Bioinformatics Consultant
positions.description: Bioinformatics consultant to the Sheltzer lab, focused on large scale cancer biomarker analyses.

positions.title: Software Engineer for Crashlytics
positions.description:
Instrumental member of an agile team developing Beta, a product to help mobile developers release beta distributions of their applications. 

Self-drove a Node.js project to dramatically improve the development/test environment for ~50 server 		engineers by implementing and socializing a tool to orchestrate Docker containers for local development. 	

Ran Girls Who Code club and summer program at Twitter Boston. Women in Engineering site lead.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Reducing OS scalability issues by developing solutions to minimize lock contention, lower memory bus usage, decrease cache miss rates, and increase algorithmic performance. 
Personal focus on cache aware algorithms, kernel memory allocations, and trap handling.

positions.title: Information Security Analyst
positions.description: Designed and implemented improvements and add-ons to existing enterprise security software, with a future patent possible. Managed developers for the design and development of additional security offerings.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Designed, optimized and implemented full-text search in the body of email messages for iOS devices. Wrote code in Objective-C using Cocoa. Code will be released in iOS 5.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Developed an Apple internal web tool to netboot remote machines into an OS build with a preinstalled third party app. Triaged binary compatibility bugs using regression testing.

publications.title: Cigarette smoke triggers the expansion of a subpopulation of respiratory epithelial cells that express the SARS-CoV-2 receptor ACE2
Systematic identification of mutations and copy number alterations associated with cancer patient prognosis
